title: Dana RS: Loop gets automatically disabled/enabled
symptom: The loop gets automatically disabled and then reenabled from time to time. When pressing the loop icon, it shows a message indicating a bluetooth connection problem, but reading stats from the pump works. The loop still seems to work when disabled, but pump-related buttons are gone.
cause: The issue is communication with the pump; when the pump is not initialized, Loop status is set to disabled. The maintainer suggests a faulty pump as the first option.
evidence_quote: When the pump is not initialized Loop status is set to disabled (and you don't see Calc an Insulin button as well) Your issue is communication with pump
